fact: The July 2026 ISR for the Tunisia Social Development Promotion Support Project reports the AMEN program MIS in service, with new modules (online citizen, case management, payment, grievance) to be developed, and an integrated beneficiary registry consolidating AMEN and other ministries' social programmes institutionalised by MoSA decree (indicator marked Yes against a 12-Jan-2026 reading).
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Tunisia Social Development Promotion Support Project (P176352)
